name: smwgraphics-among-us-skeld
title: Among Us - Skeld
description:
A request from Segment1Zone2

A slightly SMW-styled tileset of the Skeld map from Among Us. It has solid foreground tiles, background tiles, semisolids, bridges, tables, small decorations, and large decorations, and the .zip comes with a 2D representation of Skeld itself.

Crewmate-style sprites and Mario aren't included in the .zip
